integrity.proof_scope: exact exhaustive action of all 51,840 Weyl-group elements in 25 conjugacy classes

scientific_limitations: The reconstruction is of a Weyl Frobenius conjugacy class, not of the isomorphism class of a cubic surface. The sharp pair is realized by a separate published existence theorem; no explicit surface equations are provided. Older unindexed character tables might encode the same collision implicitly.
title: Near-rigidity of the double-six zeta function on smooth cubic surfaces
